verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and an OpenAPI spec is published, so the registrar can be driven programmatically without the dashboard. The evidence is thin, though: one line of API description and no CI- or headless-specific guidance. Most documented workflows are dashboard-based. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration for registrar operations, documented scoped API tokens for automation, detail on API coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
